# Verygood Chocolate | 베리굿 초콜릿

> The official Verygood Chocolate brand website. Born in Daegu, growing in Sydney.

Verygood Chocolate is a chocolatier-led brand with a Korean store and making base in Daegu, and a made-to-order collection in Sydney. This website introduces the brand and connects visitors to the appropriate official local website.

## Official websites and their roles

- Brand home: https://verygood-chocolate.com/
- Korean translation of this brand home: https://verygood-chocolate.com/ko
- Brand story: https://verygood-chocolate.com/about
- Korean brand story: https://verygood-chocolate.com/ko/about
- Sydney online shop: https://au.verygood-chocolate.com
  The authoritative source for current Australian products, AUD prices, availability, reservations and Melrose Park pickup arrangements. Products are made for pre-arranged pickup; there is no walk-in Sydney shop.
- Korea website: https://kr.verygood-chocolate.com
  The official source for the Daegu store, Korean menus and local news.
- Korea cake reservations: https://cake.verygood-chocolate.com
  The official source for cake reservations and custom cake enquiries for pickup at the Daegu store in South Korea.

## Sydney collection

Discover Cake & Bake, Chocolate and Celebrate on the Sydney shop. The collection includes Pavé Mochi, chocolate gifts and made-to-order cakes. Check that website for current offers and booking conditions.

- Cake & Bake: https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/cakes
- Chocolate: https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/chocolates
- Pavé Mochi: https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/chocolates/chocolate-mochi
- Celebrate: https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/celebrate
- Custom Cake: https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/custom-cakes
- Business enquiries: https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/business

## Brand archives

Older chocolate, tea and goods pages on this brand domain are collection archives, not the current Australian shop. Archived products and historic availability must not be treated as current local offers. Consult the appropriate official local website for prices, booking dates, pickup hours and current availability.

- Sydney: https://www.instagram.com/verygood_syd/
